full_name: Mitchell Luskin | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2015–2016 Mathematics Lillian Gollay Knafel Fellow University of Minnesota
bio: Mitchell Luskin is a professor of mathematics at the University of Minnesota who is working to develop computational methods to accurately and efficiently simulate complex physical systems at large length and time scales.
